_meta_Y2Er7w_role_refinement: TUNE finding: a mid-game team huddle (DSC03712) is NOT cleanly 'in this rally' but the players shown ARE the actual rostered starters, not substitutes. Refined role semantics used for all labels below: on_court = an actual game participant (playing, huddling, or celebrating as part of the active roster), bench = a substitute not currently in the game, spectator = non-team fan in the stands, official = referee/coach/line judge. This is closer to the product need (find real photos of a known player) than a literal mid-rally test.

_meta_D6M8cZ: D6M8cZ (2024 PNHS vs PEHS, HS indoor, boys) added as a 4th TEST album per orchestrator request, specifically to test bench/spectator-in-frame HS gym photos, since fJKdsB had zero bench-visible frames and j0g2Hw had exactly one. Labeled BEFORE any model was run on it (photos added to photos.json and this file before scripts/eval/run-vision.ts was invoked on them). Home team wears black 'NORTH' jerseys; away team ('Bengals') wears white/red. Honest finding: this 12-photo sample ALSO does not happen to contain a legible seated-bench or spectator jersey number - it is mostly genuine on-court action plus sideline coach/handshake candids. This does not contradict the orchestrator's own direct Re7kho observation (white-warmup bench #1/#12/#13/#14, black bench #21, spectator #51 in 2 of 4 photos checked) - it means bench-number visibility depends on which specific frames a photographer happened to capture in a given album, not simply 'HS gym vs beach'. Re7kho itself remains excluded from every score in this eval per the hard rule.
